tips.text: Keep your small toroids for the rank-up sacrifices and the build instead of turning them in for standing.
On the shared Circuit week, take Hildryn from the Circuit and get Baruuk the Vox Solaris way; his blueprints are a fixed standing buy.
Expect the blueprints to be the easy part; the toroid and Solaris United grind is the real cost.
Run conservation or mining solo for Solaris United standing.
Players who built Baruuk call him worth the grind.
